definitions.explanation: An educational institution that is privately funded and operated, as opposed to public or national schools. Also refers to private education as a sector.

examples.japanese: {私学|しがく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}っている→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
{私学|しがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業料|じゅぎょうりょう}→授業料：14967_jugyouryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{公立|こうりつ}→公立：08210_kouritsu⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: Private school tuition is higher than public school.

examples.japanese: {私学|しがく}⟦{助成金|じょせいきん}→助成金：11343_joseikin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利用|りよう}して→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧、⟦{学費|がくひ}→学費：04706_gakuhi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{負担|ふたん}→負担：09752_futan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{軽減|けいげん}する→軽減する：25372_keigensuru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: You can reduce the burden of tuition fees by using the private school subsidy system.

notes:
USAGE:
An abbreviation of ⟦{私立|しりつ}→私立：00370_shiritsu⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧ (private school). Used in both educational discussions and administrative/policy contexts. Contrasts with ⟦{公立|こうりつ}→公立：08210_kouritsu⟧ (public) and ⟦{国立|こくりつ}→国立：04153_kokuritsu⟧ (national).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {私学|しがく}⟦{助成金|じょせいきん}→助成金：11343_joseikin⟧ (private school subsidy)
- {私学|しがく}⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧ (private school management)
- {私学|しがく}⟦{振興|しんこう}→振興：00471_shinkou⟧ (private school promotion)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{私立|しりつ}→私立：00370_shiritsu⟧: private (institution) — the full, more common term
- ⟦{公立|こうりつ}→公立：08210_kouritsu⟧: public (institution) — government-funded schools
- ⟦{国立|こくりつ}→国立：04153_kokuritsu⟧: national (institution) — nationally funded schools
